nstool v1.9.2 (https://github.com/jakcron/nstool, MIT license, (C) jakcron), Windows build.
The start screen runs it to unpack .xci / .nsp game files (runtime/gamesetup.c, unpack_packages).

prod.keys: the console keys nstool needs, copied here from this machine's emulator folder.
